requirements.title: Four notification operations with JSON schemas, following the Industry Core KIT
requirements.statement: The OpenAPI specification of the reference implementation shall define the operations NewPassportIssued, BatteryRepaired, BatteryBecameWaste and PassportEnded as POST operations whose path and operationId equal the operation name, each with a request body made of the MessageHeader 3.0.0 header and a JSON schema of the operation's content of Table 4.4 of the CX-0160-4 amendment proposal, and with the API version only in info.version, as the notification rules of the Industry Core KIT require.
requirements.rationale: PrR-CXD-019 applies to the reference implementation repository the convention that Industry Core KIT, research note section 4.4 states, as section 2 of the conventions note of the Tractus-X reference implementations decides; Francesco accepted the folder layout on 2026-11-09. requirements.title: Conformance tests run against the in-process binding and the connector binding
requirements.statement: The conformance tests of the reference implementation repository battery-passport-after-first-life, path tck/, shall run with one test code against the in-process binding and against the Tractus-X connector binding of the reference server.
requirements.rationale: PrR-CXD-029 applies to the reference implementation repository the end-to-end test convention of tractusx-edc edc-tests/e2e (research note section 7) and the Liskov substitution principle: every implementation of a contract replaces any other without a change to its callers, so one contract test runs against each binding. The statement of 2026-11-09 named the Tractus-X simulation and the production binding of the connector client of the battery passport application; decision Q-1014 (where the reference implementation of the after-first-passport work is built) moves the reference implementation to a repository without that application, so the two bindings are those of the reference server. A rule on how the reference implementation is built is a process requirement (method.md section 6, point 5).
